generationInputs.prompt:
[Prompt en inglés para generar la imagen: An infographic titled "The Digital Slang Effect on Gen Z". The design should be modern, clean, and visually appealing, using a color palette of vibrant blues, teals, and soft purples. Incorporate abstract, subtle digital elements like glowing lines or pixelated textures in the background. The main focus will be a central graphic with three distinct sections, each representing a key aspect of slang's impact.

Section 1: "Conexión Instantánea" (Instant Connection)

Visual: Two stylized, diverse Gen Z individuals with speech bubbles containing emojis and short slang terms (e.g., "LOL", "POV", "FYP"). Lines connecting them to symbolize rapid communication.
Text: Small, clear text stating a statistic about speed of communication (e.g., "75% of Gen Z prefer concise, informal communication").
Section 2: "Identidad y Pertenencia" (Identity & Belonging)

Visual: A group of diverse Gen Z individuals forming a loose circle, with a subtle glow or aura around them, representing community. Icons related to social media platforms (TikTok, Instagram) are subtly integrated.
Text: A brief statement about how slang fosters group identity (e.g., "Slang creates unique tribal codes").
Section 3: "Brecha Generacional" (Generational Gap)

Visual: Two distinct figures: one representing Gen Z (modern, casual attire) and another representing an older generation (more formal, slightly confused expression). A subtle, almost invisible, barrier or question mark between them.
Text: A statistic about potential misunderstandings (e.g., "70% of educators note negative impact on formal writing").
Include smaller text boxes with brief examples of slang terms and their meanings (e.g., "Cringe: vergüenza ajena", "POV: punto de vista", "De chill: relajado"). The overall aesthetic should be dynamic and youthful, reflecting the Gen Z demographic.]


}
